compute.cost_note: regex detectors are stdlib; the three spaCy-enhanced constructions need en_core_web_sm

do_not_use_when: you need the passive or stacked-PP constructions without spaCy (those report available false)
you want an AI/human verdict; densities are descriptive and the regex detectors are heuristic

examples.description: Construction densities against a personal baseline

purpose: Interpretable syntactic-construction density audit. Names the constructions behind an opaque POS-bigram KL shift (clefts, pseudo-clefts, existential there, extraposition, correlatives, concessive and participial openers, fronted adverbials, parenthetical insertions; plus agented and agentless passives and stacked prepositional phrases when spaCy is available) and reports each one's density per 1,000 words, with top hits and optional baseline comparison.
use_when: variance_audit's POS-bigram KL moved and you want the shift in craft terms (which constructions)
comparing a draft's construction habits against the writer's own baseline (--baseline-dir)
checking whether a revision pass multiplied clefts, fronted adverbials or passives
